nodes.text:
In recent days, foreign media including CNN, BBC, and the Washington Post have reported a spike in human metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases in China, alleging that it has overwhelmed hospitals, with some attempting to draw parallels to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Commenting on the matter, https://t.co/k3aVqCvWKT
